text: In the Stockholm suburb of Blackeberg in 1982, twelve-year-old Oskar spends his evenings imagining revenge, until Eli, who seems to be a girl his age, [moves in next door|origin|strangers who arrive] with a man named Håkan. The two children tap coded messages through their shared wall, while Håkan [kills to bring Eli blood|wants|feeding on the living]. Eli urges Oskar to stand up to [the boys who torment him|who_suffers|the abused and bullied], and when Eli asks to be invited in, Oskar learns [what happens when he says no|rules|it must be let in].
